about: The smoke suite run by tools/dev/smoke.ps1. Each scenario is one hidden test run through shoot.ps1. Fields: name; about (what it checks, for the player); script (dev actions, tools/dev/README.md: times from app start, about 2 s after launch); shots (seconds after launch to capture, as on a quiet PC: a beat after the last action; on a busy PC they move on with the script's clock; a shot whose window, or the scenario's window, isn't there or drawn yet waits for it, up to 10 s); settings (extra settings.json members, starting with a comma); window (also capture this window, by part of its title); desk (also capture every window where it sits); mind (true: point the profile at tools/dev/mock_mind.py; "chatgpt": start tools/dev/mock_chatgpt.py, a stand-in ChatGPT plan, instead, for the scenario to sign in to, its address written {mind} in the script); mindReply; mindRequests (the least the mock must be asked); expect (regexes, case-sensitive, that some log line must match); forbid (more regexes no log line may match, on top of ERROR, Exception and SCRIPT ERROR); ignore (regexes for known harmless lines); beside (first start hidden stand-ins for the player's own app, copies that aren't test runs: one holds a one-copy lock of their own, never the player's, a second must quit at once, and the scenario runs beside them). The top-level ignore applies to every scenario. Calibrate expect and ignore from real runs; never loosen forbid to make a run pass. Which run in a check (smoke.ps1 -Changed, as check.ps1 runs it): every scenario when a file matching one of all changed (shared code and the harness itself); each scenario whose covers match a changed file; and boot whenever a file matching app changed (anything the app runs). Patterns are wildcards on paths from the checkout's root, with forward slashes. READMEs never count (a character's persona.md does: the app reads it), so a change to tests or docs alone runs none; with no list of what changed (git couldn't say, or on main itself), every scenario runs.
